output_list.code: function batchTransfer(address[] _receivers, uint256 _value) public whenNotPaused returns (bool) {
output_list.reason: The function batchTransfer will transfer the same amount of tokens to multiple addresses in one transaction. The amount of tokens to be transferred is determined by the input parameter _value. If the input parameter _value is set to 0, then no tokens will be transferred. This is a vulnerability because attackers can set _value to 0 to prevent any transfers. This can be exploited to drain all tokens from the contract.
